messages:
alex: Quick sync — planning to push quant profile v1.12 + kernel 2.4 staggered rollout this Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC. Who can own the deploy window and run the smoke checklist? Need rollback readiness too. :eyes:
carla: I can be deploy owner for the first two regions (us-west/us-east). prefer 02:00 UTC. Will need canary slice.
ben: I can take the later region handoff (eu). what's the canary size? also do we need KV-cache bump?
jaime: Ping on config diff — is there a feature flag? want to ensure fallback path uses kernel 2.3 binary if anything fails.
alex: yes — rollout config:
```
- model: llama-13b-v2
- quant_profile: v1.12
- kernel: 2.4
- rollout_policy:
  - canary: 5%
  - fallback_kernel: 2.3
  - max_latency_increase_pct: 20
```
carla: thx. I'll run these smoke steps after deploy:
1) sanity gen (seq_len=256) x10
2) cost/latency dashboard check
3) KV-hit-rate sanity
4) perf regression probe on top endpoints
ben: Add a quick embedding sanity for the reranker flows.
jaime: For rollback: what's the quick revert?
alex: revert CLI:
```
rdeploy rollback --deployment-id $ID --to-kernel 2.3 --quant-profile v1.11
```
also ops playbook note: if tail latency > 2x baseline or error-rate spike > 1%, abort and rollback. :warning:
deploy-bot: Scheduled window created: Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC. Reminder 30m before. (https://redwood.internal/runbooks/quant-v1.12)
carla: I'll claim 01:30 UTC slot for smoke run. tagging @ben @jaime for pre-checks.
ben: ack. I'll prepare canary dashboards and a short evaluation prompt set.
jaime: I'll add a test to the canary eval harness and put a few prompt seeds in PR #4217.
alex: thanks team. If anything blocks, drop notes here and call paging list. :rocket:
